01

Digital media · FLF Law

Building a clear and consistent professional presence

Talal manages Instagram content for Faisal Bin Adel Abu Khalaf Office for Law and Legal Consultations. His work includes planning content, creating posts and stories, writing captions, and maintaining a consistent brand.

  • Content planning

02

Engineering · InvestIN

Exploring engineering through hands-on challenges

A multidisciplinary programme covering aerospace, civil, materials, sustainability, mechanical, biomedical, and electrical engineering. The final team pitch proposed a vibration-based device for detecting errors in machines.

03

Innovation · Robotics

VEX Design Award & World Championship qualification

Talal won the Design Award at a VEX Robotics competition in Saudi Arabia and qualified for the VEX Robotics World Championship.

His experience also includes recognition from the NASA International Space Apps Challenge, VEX Robotics volunteering, and the Saudi Federation for Robotics & RC Sports.

Talal is the developer of TFA Games, a collection of arcade games playable on mobile and desktop.
